method: Projection along source glTF Z onto Face_SKIN; signed gap skinZ-browZ positive in front. Finite vertex+triangle-centroid checks, not full continuous collision or simultaneous expression blend proof.

browSurface.alphaSampling: Bilinear at existing vertex/triangle-centroid UVs, glTF top-left origin; alpha>=0.5 is a reporting subset, not a change to BLEND rendering.
